transcript.content: Hi, it's good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I just... I've been feeling really bad lately. Like everything that goes wrong at work or with the house is my fault. I just feel like I'm a bad employee and a bad homeowner... like I deserve to lose everything I've worked for.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful event?
It's... it's been going on for a while. About two years and three months, I think. It started after I bought my townhouse. Just... the pressure of trying to keep it up started to build, and... yeah.
Do these feelings mainly happen when you’re thinking about your townhouse and keeping it up?
Um... I'm not really sure. I guess it's not just the house. It's... it's kind of everything. I haven't really paid attention to exactly when it happens.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about many different things, not just your townhouse?
I don't know... I guess so. I just worry a lot, generally.
Do you feel this way mainly because of the stress of owning and maintaining your townhouse?
Um... no, I don't think so. I mean... I don't really know why it's happening. Like I said, I'm just not sure.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most days?
Um... I haven't really thought about it like that. I don't really keep track of my mood, so... I couldn't really say.
Do you spend a lot of time worrying almost every day?
I mean... I guess it's most days. I don't know if it's a lot of time, but... yeah, it's pretty often.
Do you feel sad or down most days?
I mean... you just asked me that. I don't really know. Like I said, I don't really pay attention to that kind of thing.
Do you often find it hard to control or stop your worrying?
I don't know... I guess sometimes it's hard. But... I don't really know if it's out of control or anything. It's just... normal worrying, I think.
Have these feelings been making it hard for you to function at work or take care of things at home?

I guess... a little. I mean, I'm still working. It just... takes a lot more effort lately to keep up with basic things. I've made some mistakes, so my supervisor actually started checking in on my performance. And... I don't know, my townhouse is a lot messier than I can usually stand. I haven't really been going to any social plans either. Just... it's hard to keep up right now.
Have you lost interest in things you usually enjoy?

I guess so... I used to do things. Like... plan brunches, or paint in the spare room. Sometimes hiking, or those networking events. But lately... I don't know. They just feel like tasks. Like I'm just... pretending to care about them, I guess.
Lately, have you been feeling sad or down most of the day?
I don't know... I guess sometimes. I mean, I wouldn't say I'm sad all the time. It's just... I don't know, maybe a little down. But it's not like I'm crying every day or anything.
Before this started about two years ago, had you ever gone through another period in your life when you felt this same kind of loss of interest and difficulty keeping up?
I... I'm not really sure. I don't think so. I mean... I've always been pretty driven, I guess. I don't really remember feeling quite like this before.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt down or depressed most of the day nearly every day?
I don't think so. Like I said... I wouldn't say it's every single day. I just feel kind of... blank, mostly. But I wouldn't call it being depressed all day long.
When you start worrying, does it usually feel hard to stop?
I don't really know. I don't think I worry a lot, to be honest. So... no, not really.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
Um... I guess so. Sometimes it's hard to focus on work, but... I don't know. I get distracted, I suppose. It's not really a big deal.
Have you been feeling tired or low on energy lately?
Um... not really. I mean... maybe a little, but nothing out of the ordinary, I guess. I don't think I'm unusually tired.
Before the past couple of years, was there ever another time in your life when you went through a similar period of losing interest in things and struggling to keep up?
Um... no. I don't think so. I don't really remember anything like that before. Just... just recently, I guess.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Most nights I just... lie awake for hours. Just listening to the house settle, I suppose. And then... I usually wake up around three or four, and I can't really get back to sleep before work. So... yeah.
Do you feel like you worry too much?
Um... I don't think so. I mean... I worry about normal things, I guess. But... not really more than anyone else, I suppose. Just... average, I guess.
